# Billing

> View your current plan, manage payment methods, and adjust team seats.

The Billing page shows your organization's subscription details and provides controls for managing payments and team size.

<img src="https://mintcdn.com/forgoodaiinc/Y_SEC3iavYl5Qnon/images/admin/admin-billing.jpg?fit=max&auto=format&n=Y_SEC3iavYl5Qnon&q=85&s=cf26c496ef3ae4d66592704db3695c0f" alt="Billing page showing current plan, billing interval, validity, next payment, payment method, and team seats" style={{ borderRadius: '12px', marginTop: '8px', marginBottom: '16px' }} width="1260" height="720" data-path="images/admin/admin-billing.jpg" />

## Subscription Details

| Field | Description |
| - | - |
| **Current plan** | Your active plan name and trial status (if applicable) |
| **Plan interval** | Monthly or Annual billing cycle |
| **Valid till** | Subscription expiration date with countdown |
| **Next payment** | Amount due at the next billing cycle |
| **Payment method** | Card on file or **Add payment method** to set one up |
| **Team seats** | Number of seats used out of total available |

## Managing Your Subscription

| Action | Description |
| - | - |
| **Manage subscription** | View invoice history and modify subscription settings |
| **Change plan** | Upgrade or downgrade your plan |
| **Add payment method** | Add a credit card or other payment method |
| **Manage users** | Jump to [User Management](/admin/user-management) to add or remove team members |
| **Adjust seats** | Increase or decrease the number of available seats in your plan |
